import re

# Matching integers
pattern_integer = r"^-?\d+$"
print(re.match(pattern_integer, "123"))      # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 3), match='123'>
print(re.match(pattern_integer, "-45"))     # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 3), match='-45'>
print(re.match(pattern_integer, "0"))      # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 1), match='0'>
print(re.match(pattern_integer, "12.3"))    # Output: None
print(re.match(pattern_integer, "abc"))     # Output: None

# Matching floating-point numbers
pattern_float = r"^-?\d+\.\d+$"
print(re.match(pattern_float, "12.34"))    # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 5), match='12.34'>
print(re.match(pattern_float, "-0.1"))     # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 4), match='-0.1'>
print(re.match(pattern_float, "12"))       # Output: None
print(re.match(pattern_float, ".5"))       # Output: None
print(re.match(pattern_float, "abc"))     # Output: None

# Matching integers or floating-point numbers
pattern_number = r"^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$"
print(re.match(pattern_number, "123"))      # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 3), match='123'>
print(re.match(pattern_number, "-4.5"))     # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 4), match='-4.5'>
print(re.match(pattern_number, "0.0"))      # Output: <re.Match object; span=(0, 3), match='0.0'>
print(re.match(pattern_number, "abc"))     # Output: None
```
